message: a ddt assigned to a variable inside an if/case/loop arm and contributed after that arm needs a controlling condition that is constant for the whole run (LRM 4.5.15)
description: This condition depends on the solution, or the arm is a loop body, so the operator's history would not advance on the steps the arm is not taken, and the derivative it reports would be wrong.
actions: Move the `ddt` into the contribution itself.
Or make the condition depend on parameters only.
